deadline.value: Fall 2027 PhD applications for Biological Sciences are due January 8, 2027.
deadline.quote: Biological Sciences * Computer Science * Economics * English History Philosophy Theology January 8, 2027

gre_general.value: GRE General is optional for the Biological Sciences PhD.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are optional for the PhD program

gre_subject.value: The GRE Subject test is recommended but not required, so it is optional.

supervisor.value: The biology PhD pages do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: An official page reports that 96% of students in the program had stipends or scholarships, but its figures are from 2012-2013.
funding.quote: In the biological sciences program, 50 (96%) students had stipends and/or scholarships

entry_route.value: Applicants need a four-year bachelor's degree; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: applicants must hold a four-year bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in the United States

also.quote: bachelor's degree, and if applicable, master's degree

notes: A WebSearch summary said this PhD is on hiatus, but the GSAS programs-of-study page lists only Classics as on hiatus and the GSAS deadline page lists the Biological Sciences PhD for Fall 2027.
name: Ph.D. in Biological Sciences
